messages:
Alex (PM): Quick tradeoff thread: Sales pushed back asking for tenant SSO + SCIM + Salesforce connector for pilot customers. Eng estimates ~2w to do properly. Option A: delay launch by 2 weeks and include integrations. Option B: ship on time (no integrations) and treat them as v1 priorities with an opt-in pilot plan. Need a call by EOD.

Zoe (Sales): Pilot customers (Acme + BuildCo) said integrations are high signal. They might postpone their rollout if we don't have SCIM. Not ideal.

Priya (Eng): Realistically SCIM + SSO is not trivial because we need mapping, provisioning, and SAML failure modes covered. 2w is tight but doable if we cut noncritical analytics.

Noah (Data): Analytics cut ? Which parts? We can drop the advanced per-route cohort charts and keep basic usage events. That saves ~5 engineer-days across infra + frontend.

Linh (Design): Removing advanced charts is ok. We'll ship a simplified metrics panel and a clear note that richer reporting is coming in v1. I can deliver mocks in 2 days.

Alex (PM): So tradeoff idea: keep launch date but cut advanced analytics and postpone in-product connectors; offer enterprise pilot for Acme with a temporary SSO proxy and a manual CSV user import option. Pilot contract terms: we give 8 weeks of priority funnel for connectors.

Zoe (Sales): Manual CSV import + short-term proxy could work to keep Acme. They need clear SLA and a plan. They asked for a date for SCIM.

Priya (Eng): Proxy approach: we can stand up a lightweight sso-proxy service that handles SAML assertions and does user mapping. Its brittle but can be monitored. Estimate: ~3 dev-days + SRE config. Noah and I can own it.

Noah (Data): We need to flag telemetry: add a tag `pilot_sso` to events so we can measure auth failures and help debug. I can add that quickly.

exec-bot: FYI execs notified: memo queued for 10:30 update - contains both options + recommended A/B.

Alex (PM): I'm leaning B (ship on time + pragmatic pilot shims) because marketplace momentum matters. But we must commit to SCIM timeline and allocate a sprint in the next cycle.

Zoe (Sales): B with a condition: we get a written pilot commitment and an internal roadmap date for SCIM. If we can't promise a date, they won't sign.

Priya (Eng): Agree to B if leadership signs off on the follow-up sprint allocation. We need that commitment to avoid endless scope creep.

Linh (Design): I'll prepare the simplified metrics UI and the CSV import CTA copy. Also a clear banner that connectors are "coming soon" with an ETA link.

Alex (PM): Decision (consensus): B. Actions: @Priya stand up sso-proxy and add rollback; @Noah add `pilot_sso` telemetry; @Linh deliver simplified metrics + CSV import copy; @Zoe get pilot commit signature from Acme; I'll update roadmap and put SCIM on the next sprint (owner: Eng). Execs will get a follow-up with dates.

Priya (Eng): Starting sso-proxy spike now. Will post short design doc in #eng-auth and link here.

Noah (Data): Adding telemetry PR to the backlog, should be ready in 24h.

Zoe (Sales): I'll chase legal & Acme.

Alex (PM): Good. We'll do a 09:30 standup tomorrow to verify pilot signoff and confirm rollback plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
